ctx.x: And it says they had Harry Barken on trumpet; Lloyd Allen, trombone; H.L. Brassfield, saxophone; Henry Starr, piano and leader, and...
I told you I...when Jelly Roll left me up there that night that I had to go out and get Henry. That was his first job in a cabaret.
